<script type="text/babel">
// Main app entry.

const { useState: useAppS, useRef: useAppR, useEffect: useAppE, useCallback: useAppC } = React;

function App() {
  const defaultsRaw = document.getElementById('tweak-defaults').textContent
    .replace(/\/\*EDITMODE-BEGIN\*\//g, '')
    .replace(/\/\*EDITMODE-END\*\//g, '')
    .trim();
  const defaults = JSON.parse(defaultsRaw);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useAppS(defaults);
  const bankRef = useAppR(null);
  const nativeBridgeAvailable = !!window.pulp
    && typeof window.pulp.on === 'function'
    && typeof window.pulp.postMessage === 'function';
  const [nativeHydrated, setNativeHydrated] = useAppS(!nativeBridgeAvailable);
  const [nativeHydration, setNativeHydration] = useAppS(null);
  const [resolution, setResolution] = useAppS(null);
  const acceptNativeState = useAppC((state) => {
    setNativeHydrated(false);
    setNativeHydration(state);
    setSettings(current => ({ ...current, bandCount: state.n }));
    setSnapshotStatus({ A: !!state.snapshots.A, B: !!state.snapshots.B });
    const library = window.SpectrNativePatterns.parse(state.patternsJson);
    if (library) {
      setUserPatterns(library.patterns);
      setDefaultId(library.defaultId);
    }
  }, []);

  // The native processor owns restored state. Ask for it only after this
  // listener exists, then keep React's initial defaults read-only until the
  // matching layout, field, and viewport have all landed.
  useAppE(() => {
    if (!nativeBridgeAvailable) return;
    const unsubscribeHydration = window.pulp.on('processing_state_hydrate', (message) => {
      const state = window.SpectrNativeState.parse(message && message.payload);
      if (!state) {
        console.error('[Spectr] rejected malformed native hydration payload');
        return;
      }
      acceptNativeState(state);
    });
    const unsubscribeResolution = window.pulp.on('spectral_resolution', (message) => {
      const payload = message && message.payload;
      const represented = payload && Number(payload.represented_bands);
      const active = payload && Number(payload.active_bands);
      const minHz = payload && Number(payload.min_hz);
      const maxHz = payload && Number(payload.max_hz);
      if (!Number.isInteger(represented) || !Number.isInteger(active)
          || active <= 0 || represented < 0 || represented > active
          || !Number.isFinite(minHz) || !Number.isFinite(maxHz)) {
        console.error('[Spectr] rejected malformed resolution payload');
        return;
      }
      const bank = bankRef.current;
      if (bank) {
        const expectedMin = Math.pow(10, bank.view.lmin);
        const expectedMax = Math.pow(10, bank.view.lmax);
        const closeEnough = (a, b) => Math.abs(a - b) <= Math.max(0.001, b * 1e-5);
        if (bank.N !== active || !closeEnough(minHz, expectedMin)
            || !closeEnough(maxHz, expectedMax)) return;
      }
      setResolution({ represented, active });
    });
    const resolutionRefresh = setInterval(() => {
      try {
        Promise.resolve(window.pulp.postMessage('spectral_resolution_request', {},
          'spectr-spectral-resolution-refresh')).catch(() => {});
      } catch {}
    }, 1000);
    try {
      window.pulp.postMessage('editor_ready', {}, 'spectr-editor-ready');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Spectr] native hydration request failed', error);
    }
    return () => {
      if (typeof unsubscribeHydration === 'function') unsubscribeHydration();
      if (typeof unsubscribeResolution === 'function') unsubscribeResolution();
      clearInterval(resolutionRefresh);
    };
  }, [acceptNativeState]);

  useAppE(() => {
    if (!nativeHydration || settings.bandCount !== nativeHydration.n) return;
    let frame = 0;
    let cancelled = false;
    const apply = () => {
      const bank = bankRef.current;
      if (!bank || bank.N !== nativeHydration.n) {
        if (!cancelled) frame = requestAnimationFrame(apply);
        return;
      }
      bank.hydrateProcessingState(nativeHydration);
      setNativeHydration(null);
      setNativeHydrated(true);
    };
    // FilterBank's child effect normally installs sharedState before this
    // parent effect runs. Apply synchronously when it is ready; retain RAF only
    // as the retry path for an unusually late ref.
    apply();
    return () => { cancelled = true; cancelAnimationFrame(frame); };
  }, [nativeHydration, settings.bandCount]);

  const [info, setInfo] = useAppS({ N: settings.bandCount, zoom: '1.00' });
  const [dspMode, setDspMode] = useAppS('fft');
  const [visualizationMode, setVisualizationMode] = useAppS('both');
  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useAppS('sculpt'); // sculpt|level|boost|flare|glide
  const [analyzerMode, setAnalyzerMode] = useAppS('peak'); // peak|avg|both|off
  const [status, setStatus] = useAppS('');
  const [snapshotStatus, setSnapshotStatus] = useAppS({ A: false, B: false });
  const [managerOpen, setManagerOpen] = useAppS(false);
  const [saveDialogOpen, setSaveDialogOpen] = useAppS(false);

  // Pattern store
  // Plugin state is the sole preset authority in native hosts. Browser
  // previews retain localStorage, but native must neither seed from nor write
  // to that unrelated persistence domain while hydration is pending.
  const [userPatterns, setUserPatterns] = useAppS(() =>
    nativeBridgeAvailable ? [] : window.Spectr.loadStore());
  const [defaultId, setDefaultId] = useAppS(() =>
    nativeBridgeAvailable ? 'factory:flat' : window.Spectr.loadDefaultId());
  useAppE(() => {
    if (!nativeBridgeAvailable) window.Spectr.saveStore(userPatterns);
  }, [nativeBridgeAvailable, userPatterns]);
  useAppE(() => {
    if (!nativeBridgeAvailable) window.Spectr.saveDefaultId(defaultId);
  }, [defaultId, nativeBridgeAvailable]);

  const fireStatus = useAppC((msg) => {
    setStatus(msg + '|' + Date.now());
    if (/SNAPSHOT ([AB]) CAPTURED/.test(msg)) {
      const slot = msg.match(/SNAPSHOT ([AB])/)[1];
      setSnapshotStatus(s => ({ ...s, [slot]: true }));
    }
  }, []);

  const applyPattern = useAppC((p) => {
    const b = bankRef.current;
    if (!b) return;
    const gains = window.Spectr.resolveGains(p, b.N);
    b.setGains(gains);
    fireStatus(`APPLIED "${p.name}"`);
  }, [fireStatus]);

  const clearAll = useAppC(() => {
    const b = bankRef.current;
    if (!b) return;
    if (b.clearGains) b.clearGains(); else b.setGains(new Array(b.N).fill(0));
    fireStatus('CLEARED GAINS');
  }, [fireStatus]);

  const resetAll = useAppC(() => {
    const b = bankRef.current;
    if (!b) return;
    if (b.resetAll) b.resetAll(); else b.reset();
    setSnapshotStatus({ A: false, B: false });
    fireStatus('RESET ALL');
  }, [fireStatus]);

  const [allMuted, setAllMuted] = useAppS(false);
  useAppE(() => {
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      const b = bankRef.current;
      if (!b || !b.allMuted) return;
      const v = b.allMuted();
      setAllMuted(prev => prev === v ? prev : v);
    }, 250);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, []);

  const currentGains = useAppC(() => {
    const b = bankRef.current;
    return b ? b.getGains() : new Array(settings.bandCount).fill(0);
  }, [settings.bandCount]);

  const acceptPatternLibrary = useAppC((body) => {
    const library = window.SpectrNativePatterns.parse(body && body.patterns_json);
    if (!library) throw new Error('native pattern library response was malformed');
    setUserPatterns(library.patterns);
    setDefaultId(library.defaultId);
    return body;
  }, []);
  const patternCommand = useAppC((type, payload, fallback) => {
    if (!nativeBridgeAvailable) { fallback && fallback(); return Promise.resolve(null); }
    return Promise.resolve(window.pulp.postMessage(type, payload, 'spectr-' + type))
      .then(response => {
        const body = response && response.payload ? response.payload : response;
        if (!response || response.ok !== true || !body || body.ok !== true)
          throw new Error((body && body.error) || 'native pattern command rejected');
        return acceptPatternLibrary(body);
      }).catch(error => {
        fireStatus('PRESET OPERATION FAILED');
        console.error('[Spectr] native pattern command failed', error);
        return null;
      });
  }, [acceptPatternLibrary, fireStatus, nativeBridgeAvailable]);
  const nextPatternName = useAppC(() => {
    const names = new Set(userPatterns.map(pattern => pattern.name.toUpperCase()));
    let number = 1, candidate = '';
    do { candidate = 'PATTERN ' + String(number++).padStart(2, '0'); }
    while (names.has(candidate));
    return candidate;
  }, [userPatterns]);
  const saveCurrentPattern = useAppC((name) => patternCommand(
    'save_current_pattern', { name }, () => {
      const pattern = window.Spectr.makeUserPattern(name, currentGains());
      setUserPatterns(current => [...current, pattern]);
    }).then(body => {
      if (body || !nativeBridgeAvailable) {
        fireStatus('SAVED "' + name + '"');
        setSaveDialogOpen(false);
      }
    }), [currentGains, fireStatus, nativeBridgeAvailable, patternCommand]);
  const renamePattern = useAppC((id, name) => patternCommand(
    'rename_pattern', { id, name }, () => setUserPatterns(current => current.map(
      pattern => pattern.id === id ? { ...pattern, name } : pattern))), [patternCommand]);
  const deletePattern = useAppC((id) => patternCommand(
    'delete_pattern', { id }, () => setUserPatterns(current => current.filter(
      pattern => pattern.id !== id))).then(body => {
        if (body || !nativeBridgeAvailable) fireStatus('DELETED');
      }), [fireStatus, nativeBridgeAvailable, patternCommand]);

  // Deterministic read-only UI projection used by the executed-browser
  // and mounted-native interaction suites. It reports the same React commit
  // that paints the editor; it cannot mutate product or processor state.
  if (window.__spectrTestHooks) {
    window.__spectrTestHooks.appState = () => ({
      nativeHydrated,
      settings: { ...settings },
      editMode,
      analyzerMode,
      visualizationMode,
      snapshotStatus: { ...snapshotStatus },
      managerOpen,
      saveDialogOpen,
      userPatterns: userPatterns.map(pattern => ({
        id: pattern.id, name: pattern.name,
      })),
      defaultId,
      statusMounted: !!document.querySelector('[data-spectr-status-banner]'),
    });
  }

  // Browser previews may apply their saved default. A native editor is
  // always hydrated from host state instead.
  useAppE(() => {
    if (nativeBridgeAvailable) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      const b = bankRef.current;
      if (!b || !defaultId) return;
      const all = [...window.Spectr.FACTORY_PATTERNS, ...userPatterns];
      const p = all.find(x => x.id === defaultId);
      if (p && p.id !== 'factory:flat') {
        const gains = window.Spectr.resolveGains(p, b.N);
        b.setGains(gains);
      }
    }, 80);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, []);

  useAppE(() => {
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      const b = bankRef.current;
      if (!b) return;
      const v = b.view;
      const full = Math.log10(20000) - Math.log10(20);
      const span = v.lmax - v.lmin;
      const nextInfo = { N: b.N, zoom: (full / span).toFixed(2) };
      setInfo(previous => previous.N === nextInfo.N
        && previous.zoom === nextInfo.zoom ? previous : nextInfo);
    }, 150);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, []);

  // Focus-local shortcuts deliberately avoid Logic Musical Typing letters.
  useAppE(() => {
    const modeKeys = {
      '1': 'sculpt', '2': 'level', '3': 'boost', '4': 'flare', '5': 'glide'
    };
    const onKey = (e) => {
      const t = e.target;
      if ((typeof document.hasFocus === 'function' && !document.hasFocus())
          || e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229 || e.repeat
          || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || e.shiftKey
          || (t && (t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA'
                    || t.tagName === 'SELECT' || t.isContentEditable))
          || document.querySelector('[data-spectr-overlay="true"]')) return;
      const k = e.key;
      if (modeKeys[k]) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setEditMode(modeKeys[k]);
        fireStatus('EDIT → ' + modeKeys[k].toUpperCase());
        return;
      }
      if (k === '6') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setAnalyzerMode(m => {
          const next = m === 'peak' ? 'avg' : m === 'avg' ? 'both' : m === 'both' ? 'off' : 'peak';
          fireStatus('ANALYZER → ' + next.toUpperCase());
          return next;
        });
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [fireStatus]);

  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }} data-screen-label="Spectr main">
      <FilterBank settings={settings} sharedState={bankRef} onStatus={fireStatus} dspMode={dspMode} editMode={editMode} analyzerMode={analyzerMode} visualizationMode={visualizationMode} nativeHydrated={nativeHydrated} onNativeState={acceptNativeState} onEditModeChange={(v) => { setEditMode(v); fireStatus(`EDIT → ${v.toUpperCase()}`); }} />
      <Chrome
        resolution={resolution}
        settings={settings}
        setSettings={setSettings}
        bankRef={bankRef}
        info={info}
        status={status}
        dspMode={dspMode}
        setDspMode={(v) => { setDspMode(v); fireStatus(`DSP → ${v.toUpperCase()}`); }}
        visualizationMode={visualizationMode}
        setVisualizationMode={(v) => { setVisualizationMode(v); fireStatus(`VIEW → ${v.toUpperCase()}`); }}
        editMode={editMode}
        setEditMode={(v) => { setEditMode(v); fireStatus(`EDIT → ${v.toUpperCase()}`); }}
        analyzerMode={analyzerMode}
        setAnalyzerMode={(v) => { setAnalyzerMode(v); fireStatus(`ANALYZER → ${v.toUpperCase()}`); }}
        snapshotStatus={snapshotStatus}
        patterns={{ user: userPatterns, defaultId }}
        onApplyPattern={applyPattern}
        onOpenPatternManager={() => setManagerOpen(true)}
        onSavePattern={() => setSaveDialogOpen(true)}
        onClearAll={clearAll}
        onResetAll={resetAll}
        allMuted={allMuted}
      />
      <TweaksPanel settings={settings} setSettings={setSettings} />
      <PatternManager
        open={managerOpen}
        onClose={() => setManagerOpen(false)}
        userPatterns={userPatterns}
        setUserPatterns={setUserPatterns}
        defaultId={defaultId}
        setDefaultId={setDefaultId}
        N={info.N}
        onApply={applyPattern}
        currentGains={currentGains()}
        onStatus={fireStatus}
        onRequestSave={() => setSaveDialogOpen(true)}
        onRenamePattern={renamePattern}
        onDeletePattern={deletePattern}
      />
      <PatternSaveDialog open={saveDialogOpen} defaultName={nextPatternName()}
        onSave={saveCurrentPattern} onCancel={() => setSaveDialogOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<App />);

</script>
